title: eriocaulon sellowianum var. paranense
intro: Eriocaulon sellowianum var. paranense, commonly known as the 'Parana Eriocaulon', is a plant species in the family Eriocaulaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Eriocaulon sellowianum var. paranense include protecting against oxidative stress, inhibiting the growth of pathogens, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been identified through various studies.
